This position is looking for a highly motivated Program Manager with emphasis in FAA, DoD, and other regulatory organizations focused on FAA compliance and airspace access. Work closely with the program leadership, legal and a wide spectrum of cross-departments you will lead and support efforts focused on enabling the team to move fast and changing the industry forever. The role will be responsible for executing, and managing all FAA compliance and airspace authorization efforts for the Test & Evaluation team. Regulatory approval is frequently the pacing item for a test campaign, and this role owns clearing it.

The Test and Evaluation team at Anduril works across the entire spectrum of products and business lines, as well as all sub-surface, surface, airborne operation and test range management. Our team conducts full system level development testing, new production acceptance testing, sub-component qualification testing and much more. In short, if it involves test, we support it. If you are interested in working in an extremely innovative and fast paced environment, where your work directly makes an impact and difference in the products that are fielded this a fantastic opportunity.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Develop, implement, and maintain compliance programs to ensure adherence to FAA regulations, including Part 21, Part 91, Part 107, Part 135, or other applicable rules.

- Prepare and submit regulatory applications, including FAA Certificates of Authorization (COAs) — new, amended, and altitude/airspace expansions — 44807 exemptions, Part 107 waivers and authorizations, Certificates of Waiver, and type certification requests.

- Own the intake, prioritization, and end-to-end tracking of airspace access requests from across the company, maintaining a single authoritative system of record from initial request through FAA decision and post-approval conditions.

- Serve as a liaison with the FAA, Department of Defense (DoD), and other regulatory bodies to obtain necessary approvals for flight operations and experimental testing.

- Coordinate the non-FAA approvals that also gate flight test — including radio frequency and spectrum authorizations — so that airspace and supporting authorizations arrive in step rather than sequentially.

- Develop compliance strategies for new technologies, including autonomous systems, beyond visual line-of-sight (BVLOS) operations, and large UAS.

- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of FAA regulatory changes and provide guidance to internal stakeholders on compliance implications.

- Support audits, inspections, and internal reviews to ensure ongoing regulatory adherence.

- Work closely with engineering, flight operations, and safety teams to integrate compliance requirements into operational procedures.

- Assist in developing and maintaining regulatory documentation, manuals, and training materials related to FAA compliance.

- Provide training and guidance to company personnel on FAA compliance matters.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s degree in Aviation, Aerospace Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in FAA regulatory compliance, certification, airworthiness or equivalent experience.

- Strong knowledge of FAA regulatory frameworks, including experience with COAs, 44807 exemptions, Part 91, Part 135, or Part 107 operations.

- Experience engaging directly with FAA representatives and regulatory agencies.

- Ability to instrument and report on your own process: define the metrics that show whether approvals are keeping pace with test demand, and present them to a leadership audience.

- Familiarity with autonomous systems, UAS, and emerging aviation technologies.

- Experience in defense-related aviation programs, including interactions with the DoD or other government agencies.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements to real-world operations.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience drafting regulatory submissions and compliance documentation.

- Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment, balancing regulatory requirements with operational objectives.

- Strong organizational, leadership, and project management skills.

- Must have strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills.

- Ability to work cross-functionally and influence without direct authority.

- Must possess the ability to understand new concepts quickly; apply them accurately; organize, schedule, and coordinate work phases; and, determine the appropriate approach at the task level or, with assistance, at the project level to provide solutions to a range of complex problems.

- Strong computer and documentation experience, including comfort building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, and written procedures that other people depend on.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team; able to perform complex tasks

- Ability to travel as required

- Able to work extended hours as required

- Bias for action – if you see a problem, you want to solve and fix it

- Ability to obtain a U.S. Secret-Level security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, or equivalent work tracking and documentation systems, including building reporting on top of them.

- FAA certification or regulatory-related training (e.g., DER, DAR, Part 107 certification, or other FAA compliance training).

- Experience with Safety Management Systems (SMS) and risk-based compliance approaches.

- Experience with UAS-specific compliance issues, including BVLOS and detect-and-avoid (DAA) technologies.

- Knowledge of DCMA 8210.1D, MIL-STD airworthiness processes, or other defense-related airworthiness policies.

- Experience working directly with the FAA and Department of Defense (DoD) regulators.

- Experience working with manned aircraft personnel and familiar with aviation terminology.

- Hold FAA Private Pilot Certificate, and FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate.

- Has former DoD UAS operational experience.

We move fast at Anduril and give tremendous freedom and autonomy to our new hires to assume responsibility and exercise prudent interdisciplinary judgement. You should expect to be running at least two cross-functional projects independently within 60 days of hiring. When you join our team, you’re signing up to immediately make an impact in our organization and with our customers globally.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Strategic Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Air Dominance and Strike Division is one of Anduril's fastest growing, most technically complex divisions. We develop and build collaborative combat aircraft, missiles, and the software that powers these autonomous weapons. We are scaling production of a first-of-kind autonomous aircraft at Arsenal 1 in Ohio at a pace the defense industry has never attempted.

ABOUT THE JOB

There is no inherited supply chain strategy for this product. You define how supply risk, continuity, and supplier performance are tracked, acted on, and reported for a first-of-kind product. You build the capabilities that make the supply base resilient before a disruption hits. You do not run procurement transactions. You own whether the supply base can deliver on cost, on schedule, and at rate.

Success in this position hinges on three key facets:

- Strategy that survives contact. You work with the Supply Chain leadership to set the supply chain strategy and translate it into roadmaps, leading indicators, and decisions that hold up ensure we not limited by a vendor’s performance.

- Execution at velocity. Disruptions resolve in hours, not weeks. You diagnose the constraint, build the right people into the room, and drive the mitigation. The health of the supply chain will be reliant on you measuring the inputs and outputs effectively, and working closely with Supply Chain leadership to drive execution to plan.

- Credibility driven leadership. You earn trust across sourcing, engineering, production, quality, and supplier leadership by being rigorous, fast, and always right.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Work with Supply Chain leadership to set and own the supply chain strategy that takes a first of kind autonomous aircraft from development to rate, spanning supply assurance, supply-base resilience, and sourcing innovation

- Build supply risk intelligence into a system by identifying single points of failure across critical, long-lead, and sole-source parts, then embed actionable insight into sourcing and production decisions

- Own supplier performance and time-to-resolution on disruptions mechanisms, driving sourcing strategy to reduce single-points-of-failure on the parts that gate delivery or rate

- Translate strategy into prioritized roadmaps and measurable outcomes, then drive cross-functional decisions when supply, engineering, quality and production priorities conflict

- Build and operationalize an innovation pipeline of supplier pilots, partnerships, and new capabilities that strengthen supply continuity and long-term cost position

- Connect supplier performance and supply risk to unit cost and the integrated master schedule, so supply chain health is visible in program level financial and schedule KPIs

- Define which supply metrics drive decisions versus which report status, building leading indicator systems that enable early intervention

- Leverage quantitative models, including trade studies, sensitivity analysis, and predictive modeling, to inform sourcing strategy and resource allocation

- Prepare analysis, documentation, and briefings for internal teams, suppliers, customers, and government stakeholders

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 6+ years in supply chain strategy, sourcing, or supply program management on complex hardware programs through development and production

- Demonstrated ownership of supply risk and supplier performance on programs with aggressive timelines and rapid scale

- Proven ability to lead cross-functional transformation without direct authority

- Experience building supply chain capabilities or program management systems from scratch in environments without an established playbook

- Ability to translate complex supply and cost data into actionable strategy and clear prioritization

- Comfortable building or interpreting quantitative models to inform sourcing and program decisions

- Familiar with version control, scripting, scalable workflows, and reproducible analysis practices

- Experience leading and managing direct reports (this role will have 2 direct reports).

- Demonstrated experience executing, standardizing, and scaling training/onboarding programs across multiple physical locations or sites.

- Superb facilitation and coaching skills—able to engage and train frontline materials handlers, operations managers, and specialized industrial engineers.

We’re looking for a Senior Director to join the finance team supporting Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S), one of Anduril’s largest and fastest-growing divisions. This is a high-visibility financial leadership role responsible for owning the P&L for Anduril’s Autonomous Air Power business line within AD&S. This role is responsible for leading and developing a high-powered team that partners with business to drive product and program profitability.

The successful candidate will operate at both the strategic level — architecting sustainable financial models and shaping the division’s capital allocation — and the operational level — embedding with division and business line leaders to drive day-to-day financial rigor. This role will interface cross-functionally with senior leadership across finance, operations, production, engineering, growth, program management, and supply chain to shape and execute on the business line’s long-term business objectives.

This is a builder’s role — Fury is just the beginning.

ABOUT THE TEAM

AD&S is fundamentally reshaping the way future peer to peer conflicts are fought by developing next generation collaborative combat aircraft (like our unmanned fighter jet Fury), advanced effects (like our air-breathing cruise missile Barracuda), and the autonomy software that powers these weapons. The team is responsible for taking products from initial concept to full-rate production at-scale. The team also develops Lattice for Mission Autonomy, Anduril’s premier software platform that enables masses of Fury, Barracuda, and other robots to collaborate across various missions and environments. Our autonomous systems are the cornerstone of these capabilities, and we continually strive to push the boundaries of the possible in terms of range, autonomy, and mission capability.

- Daily partnership with Senior Leaders within AD&S to bring first class financial expertise and support to the business.

- Manage the processes for financial forecasting and budgets, and oversee the preparation of business line, product and program level financial reporting.

- Own the financial oversight and management for a portfolio of large, complex, and mission-critical programs

- Manage and scale a dedicated team in line with the needs of the business by developing and hiring best-in-class talent and implementing best practices and tools to ensure a well-controlled yet flexible finance organization.

- Lead the development of executive-level reporting and present financial insights to senior management.

- Evaluate financial performance by comparing and analyzing actual results with forecasts, highlighting trends and analyzing causes of unexpected variances.

- Work with senior AD&S and corporate finance leaders to identify and implement ways to improve business performance and finance systems, tools and processes.

- Get deep in the operations and support the team in creating bottoms-up, data-driven models to understand segmentation, pricing optimization, scenarios, and financial returns of our products and investments.

- Own performance dashboards, alerting, and investigation into KPI health. Assess the impact of financial decisions on KPIs while developing strategies which drive demonstrable impact against these metrics.

- Develop deep relationships with our customers (both internal and external) and oversee customer program reporting, monthly invoicing, and monthly financial status reporting.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA or relevant professional certification (CPA, CFA) is a plus.

- 15+ years of finance experience working for Big Tech, Defense, Large Manufacturing, or Government contracting, with 3-5 years in a senior leadership position.

- Advanced proficiency in Excel, financial modeling and data analysis tools, and experience with financial reporting tools and ERP systems (i.e. Oracle Fusion, Oracle EPM, Anaplan, Foundry).

- Demonstrated track record of owning problems end-to-end in a finance function.

- Intellectually curious - you seek to understand the why behind the numbers.

- Highly technical - you value precision and accuracy when it comes to your work, and you can rapidly dissect complex quantitative problems.

- Critical thinker - you consider problems from all angles to remove bias.

- Results-oriented - you will do whatever it takes to get the job done.

- Exceptional written and oral communication skills. You drive consensus through grounded arguments, interpersonal skills, and negotiation skills.

- Creative problem-solver - able to identify obstacles and present viable solutions.

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.

- Excited by large breadth of problems.

- Confidence to execute in highly visible and accountable positions.

- Must be authorized to work in the United States.

- Must be security clearance eligible.

- 3+ years of post-qualified experience across a broad range of finance disciplines - not someone who has done the same narrow role repeatedly.

- Experience setting up finance processes from scratch or materially redesigning how things are done.

- Advanced Excel and Power Query skills - you build data-connected models, not just spreadsheets.

- Familiarity with ERP systems, ideally Oracle.

- Strong PowerPoint skills for executive-level reporting and storytelling.

- Comfortable with AI tools and finding ways to automate manual work.

- Proficiency in HRIS platforms and project management methodologies; experience with Confluence, Airtable, and SharePoint for playbook development and tracking is a plus.

- Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril is building the technology that will transform defense and national security. Our People team is at the center of that mission, ensuring the organization scales as fast as the problems we're solving. Within People, the People & Leadership Development function is moving from early-stage pilots to enterprise-wide programs that reach every manager and leader across a complex, matrixed organization. This role sits at the heart of that transition.

ABOUT THE JOB
We are looking for a Senior People Program Manager to own the scaling of Anduril's leadership development, team coaching, and manager effectiveness programs. Today, we are running a series of successful pilots across the business in coaching, team development, and leadership summits. What we need now is someone who can take what's working, build the roadmap, and operationalize it into a centralized offering that serves the entire company. You will partner directly with People leadership to define the future state, project-plan the path to get there, and execute relentlessly. This person will be equal parts strategist and operator: comfortable presenting program outcomes to senior leadership in a QBR one day and facilitating a team offsite the next.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the transition from pilot to scale for Anduril's leadership and people development programs, including group coaching, manager and high-potential development, team onsites, leadership summits, and team effectiveness offerings.

- Build and manage the multi-year program roadmap, defining what a centralized leadership development offering looks like at Anduril by 2027 and the milestones to get there.

- Serve as the primary operator and project manager for all people development initiatives, using structured briefs, trackers, and stakeholder communication to keep work on schedule.

- Guide team’s evaluation of current pilots with a critical eye: determine what is delivering value and what needs refinement. Use qualitative feedback and quantitative data to inform those calls.

- Identify and evaluate technology solutions that can accelerate people development at scale, from coaching platforms to learning management systems.

- Help facilitate onsite and offsite experiences, owning the operational end while, when needed, leading facets of team development sessions, leadership workshops, and cross-functional summits.

- Present program strategy, progress, and outcomes to senior leadership with clarity and confidence.

- Partner across the People org and with business leaders to understand development needs, tailor programming, and build buy-in for new offerings.

- Scope the resourcing model: determine when and how to build out a bench of facilitators, coaches, or vendors to support scaled delivery.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 10+ years of experience in people development, leadership development, organizational development, or program management within a People/HR function.

- Demonstrated experience deploying leadership or manager development programs at scale within a large, matrixed organization.

- You are motivated by our mission. We are working to solve the biggest problems in defense.

- Strong project management instincts: you build structure in ambiguous environments and drive complex, cross-functional work to completion without waiting to be told what to do.

- Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to present confidently to senior leaders, facilitate workshops, and craft compelling narratives around program vision and outcomes.

- You are both high ownership and low ego, approaching everything with strong outcome orientation and high humility.

- Comfort with data: you can interpret program feedback, build a case for investment, and adjust your approach based on what the numbers say.

- You thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and get energy from building something from the ground up rather than maintaining the status quo.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Background in coaching, executive coaching, or leadership coaching (ICF certification or equivalent is a plus).

- Experience designing and facilitating team coaching, offsites, leadership workshops, or similar group development experiences.

- Experience launching new products with condensed timelines

- Experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, TPS, Six Sigma, etc.)

- Experience in defense, aerospace, or automotive manufacturing

- Experience with ERP, MRP, MES, PLM systems

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, bringing together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for time sensitive decisions, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.

Most Warfighting capabilities assume connectivity, compute, power, or a secure space to work in. On a base or near a data center, these exist. At the edge, they do not. Our warfighters need capabilities that can fight where they do. Anduril Expeditionary Systems is the business line that solves this. We build Menace, a containerized system that arrives by truck, ship, plane, or helicopter, powers on in under ten minutes, and delivers command, compute, or effects with no site prep, no bespoke basing equipment, and no specialized personnel.

The Containerized Effects team focuses on clandestine transport, storage, and launch of containerized effects. You’ll work with engineers to build enclosures, launch infrastructure, operating interfaces, and communications that let a small team proliferate munitions and non-kinetic effects with minimal support or reachback. Effect is the outcome, not the mechanism: a missile is an effect, and so is electronic warfare.

- Identify and mitigate potential risks and issues that may impact program delivery.

- Continuously seek opportunities for process improvement and efficiency within the program.

- Demonstrated experience as a self-starter, able to find and resolve issues on your own

- Experience in Program Management. Contract management of/with focused program offices

- Experience with government: business development, contract structures, budget cycles, procurement processes, program funding, and proposal processes

- Comfortable with setting and achieving goals in a complex, fast moving environments with ambiguous requirements

- Adaptive and introspective; willing to learn, teach, lead and follow

- Experience as a program or project manager in defense, tech, consulting or similar field

About the Team

The M&A Business Systems team is the tip of the spear when Anduril acquires a new company. We are a small, fast-moving team responsible for integrating acquired companies into Anduril's Oracle Fusion ERP and best in class internal tools. We operate an aggressive acquisition roadmap and run multiple integration programs in parallel at any given time, enabling operations across the U.S. and internationally.

The Role

We are seeking an early career, quick to learn Solution Analyst, M&A to join the M&A Business Systems team and own hands-on configuration, data manipulation, and integration work across our full acquisition portfolio. A successful Solution Analyst will own much of the configuration and data work related to M&A. They will also be expected to grow their skillset by being embedded in the full integration lifecycle from the moment a deal closes: involved in onsite discovery, providing fit/gap analyses, completing build/configuration, converting data, executing test scenarios, and supporting Go-Lives at acquired sites. You'll be the person who ensures a newly acquired company can actually operate from day one inside Anduril's enterprise systems across all work streams.

You will work directly with the broader M&A systems team, collaborating across EngOS/PLM (Teamcenter), home-grown manufacturing and planning systems (Forge, MRPSpeed), customer and contract mgmt (Salesforce), and the Oracle Fusion ERP core spanning procurement, inventory, order management and finance/accounting. If you thrive in high-tempo, ambiguous environments where the answer isn't in a playbook yet and you have the scars to prove you've been here before, this role was written for you.

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end data conversion for M&A integrations: extract source data, map to Oracle templates, derive business rules for undefined fields, validate data quality and leverage AI tools to eliminate manual work and build repeatable processes for future acquisitions

- Support legal entity design and intercompany configuration for new acquisitions, translating operational, accounting and legal requirements into application design decisions for ERP and satellite system teams.

- Execute system configuration for new Oracle legal entities across workstreams: DTB (Design to Build), WMS (Warehouse/Inventory Operations), PTP (Procure to Pay), OTC (Order to Cash), PTC (Projects to Close), and RTR (Record to Report).

- Plan and execute testing cycles, build and run test cases, resolve defects, and drive root cause and resolution with satellite system teams (Teamcenter, Forge, Salesforce, MRPSpeed).

- Travel onsite to acquired companies to lead discovery sessions, demos, deliver hands-on ERP training, and provide Go-Live and Hypercare support.

- Collaborate with the M&A PM and enablement functions to build and maintain standardized data templates, integration SOPs, and reusable training materials (videos, guides) that scale the team's playbook across future acquisitions.

- Partner with cross-functional satellite tool teams (PLM/Teamcenter, Forge/MES, Salesforce, WMS) to coordinate configuration changes and test dependencies on acquisition timelines.

- Operate in agile/sprint-based delivery: own your workstream, hit sprint milestones, surface blockers early, and keep integration programs moving without being told what to do next.

- Contribute to and maintain the M&A ERP knowledge base, capture design decisions, configuration documentation, and lessons learned in Airtable and Quip so future integrations start further ahead.

Required Characteristics

Anduril is an extremely fast-paced defense technology company. The M&A team runs at a pace most teams don't. The successful candidate will demonstrate:

- Bias for Action — you move fast, escalate blockers immediately, and don't wait for perfect information to make progress.

- Outcome-Oriented — you care about Day 1 Go-live working, not about process elegance. You work backward from the deadline.

- Ownership — you own your workstream end to end. If something is at risk, you raise it and you fix it.

- Agility — acquisition timelines shift. Legal entity decisions get made late. You adapt without drama.

- Dive Deep — you're comfortable in the weeds of data templates, config workbooks, and test scripts. You spot the gap before it becomes a blocker.

- Customer Focus — you treat acquired company employees as your users. You build trust with teams who are often new to enterprise systems and nervous about change.

- First Principles Thinking — you don't just replicate how the last integration was done. You ask whether it was the right way and improve the playbook.

Required Qualifications

- 3+ years of hands-on ERP experience (Oracle Fusion preferred but will accept NetSuite, SAP, or similar), including configuration, data conversion/loading, and troubleshooting — M&A integration or rapid deployment experience strongly preferred.

- Demonstrated experience executing data migrations: extracting source data, mapping to target templates, validating quality, and coordinating loads.

- Deep knowledge in at least one or more particular work streams (order to cash, procure to pay, record to report, design to build, etc.) strongly preferred

- Strong understanding of legal entity and intercompany transaction design — experience configuring new legal entities in Oracle Fusion is a significant plus.

- Proven ability to work in agile/sprint-based delivery environments; comfortable writing user stories, tracking work in PM tools (Airtable, Jira, or equivalent), and iterating quickly.

- Strong cross-functional communication skills — you can work with accounting, legal, ops, engineers, and ERP developers in the same day and adjust your communication style for each.

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% , including to acquired company sites domestically and internationally, for discovery, onboarding, testing, and Go-live support.

- U.S. Person status required (access to export-controlled data).

- Ability to work onsite full-time at primary office location.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with M&A ERP integration programs or ERP rapid deployment / accelerated implementation methodologies.

- Familiarity with connected enterprise tools: Teamcenter/PLM, Salesforce, Odoo, or similar.

- Prior experience at Big 4 consulting firms in ERP implementation practices.

- Aerospace & Defense, complex manufacturing, or government contracting industry background.

- Experience building reusable enablement content — training videos, SOPs, how-to guides — for end users who are new to ERP systems.

- Undergraduate degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain, or related field.

To achieve our vision of becoming a large-volume provider of tactical rocket motors, we will develop differentiated products and services that maximize our customers’ capabilities, and we will establish and maintain a reputation of Quality and Reliability.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril is seeking a highly skilled, mission-driven, highly organized, detail-oriented, and responsive Program Manager to provide critical tactical support and operational oversight for our strategic defense clients, driving the adoption, expansion, and long-term success of Anduril's cutting-edge Rocket Motor Systems. You will serve as a trusted advisor, deeply understanding client operational requirements and translating them into impactful solutions that leverage our solutions. This role requires a unique blend of strategic thinking, technical aptitude, exceptional relationship-building skills, and a passionate commitment to national security. In addition, this role achieves results by focused on the day-to-day management of client accounts, ensuring the smooth deployment, ongoing functionality, and optimal performance of Anduril's Rocket Motor Systems. You will be the primary point of contact for operational queries, issue resolution, logistics coordination, and direct support to ensure our military and government customers' success.

ABOUT THE JOB

- Strategic Client Engagement:

- Serve as the lead point of contact for key defense accounts focused on Rocket Motor Systems, establishing and nurturing strong, enduring relationships with military leadership, program offices, and operational end-users.

- Develop a deep understanding of client mission objectives, operational environments, and strategic priorities to proactively identify and position Anduril's Rocket Motor Systems.

- Navigate complex government procurement processes, contracting mechanisms (e.g., DIU, SBIR, OTA), and funding cycles to ensure successful program execution and growth.

- Champion client needs internally, collaborating closely with Anduril's Engineering, Product, and Integration teams to inform product roadmap and ensure timely, high-quality solution delivery.

- Daily Client Operations & Support:

- Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, managing day-to-day communications, operational requests, and urgent support needs related to Rocket Motor systems.

- Address client inquiries promptly and effectively, providing direct solutions or coordinating with internal technical support, engineering, and logistics teams for rapid resolution of issues.

- Track and document all client interactions, support tickets, and operational feedback in the CRM system (e.g., Salesforce) with meticulous detail.

- Ensure clients receive timely updates on product enhancements, revisions, and relevant technical documentation.

- Solution Adoption & Growth:

- Drive the successful adoption and integration of Anduril's Rocket Motor systems into client operations, demonstrating clear mission value and operational superiority.

- Identify and cultivate opportunities for expansion within existing accounts, including upselling new features, capabilities, cross-selling adjacent Anduril technologies, and securing follow-on contracts.

- Develop comprehensive account plans, sales strategies, and proposals that align with client requirements and Anduril's strategic objectives.

- Conduct compelling technical demonstrations, presentations, and product briefings to diverse audiences, from technical specialists to general officers.

- Tactical Execution & Deliverables:

- Coordinate the scheduling and logistics for product demonstrations, training sessions, and field support visits with clients and internal teams.

- Monitor the operational status and usage data of deployed Rocket Motor systems, proactively identifying potential issues or areas for improvement in coordination with technical teams.

- Process and track client orders for system upgrades, spare parts, consumables, and additional training modules.

- Facilitate contract renewals by ensuring all terms and conditions of current agreements are met and documented.

- Prepare and deliver routine operational status reports, usage metrics, and support summaries to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Internal Coordination & Problem Solving:

- Act as the liaison between client operational teams and Anduril's internal engineering, product, and field support teams to ensure client requirements are accurately relayed and understood for immediate action.

- Troubleshoot basic technical issues on-site or remotely, escalating complex problems to the appropriate technical experts.

- Support the integration and qualification and testing of new Rocket Motor system by coordinating client access and feedback.

- Assist in identifying and documenting client needs for future product features based on immediate operational feedback.

- Performance & Reporting:

- Forecast and track key account metrics, including revenue targets, program milestones, and operational deployment success.

- Provide regular, insightful reports to internal leadership on account status, strategic opportunities, competitive landscape, and challenges.

- Manage contract negotiations, ensuring favorable terms that support long-term partnerships and Anduril's business goals.

- Domain Expertise & Market Intelligence:

- Maintain an expert-level understanding of Anduril's Rocket Motor system portfolio, including technical specifications, operational advantages, and future development pathways.

- Stay abreast of industry trends in rocket motor systems, applications and defense technologies, as well as evolving national security threats and doctrine.

- Gather and synthesize client feedback and market intelligence to contribute to Anduril's product development and competitive strategy.

- Compliance & Documentation:

- Ensure all client activities comply with contractual agreements, security protocols, and relevant government regulations.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records, contact information, and equipment inventory.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Education & Experience:

- Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Engineering, Computer Science), Business Administration, or a related discipline.

- 8-10+ years of progressive experience in program/project management, sales, or business development within the defense, aerospace, or government contracting sector.

- Experience with military operations, rocket motor systems, missile, ballistics, or complex technical product support is highly preferred.

- Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance, or the ability to obtain and maintain one, is required.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and maintain exceptional attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.

- Proven track record of successfully managing complex client relationships and closing significant contracts with U.S. government entities (DoD, IC, etc.).
